# dsh-deepseek-pricing
**English** · 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that answers the two questions that decide a DeepSeek API bill: **is the A
PI on peak (full price) or off-peak (exactly half price) right now**, and **when does it flip**. It
also reports today's peak windows and the per-model prices for that tier from a **bundled rate card*
* transcribed from DeepSeek's pricing page on **2026-10-15** (`data_metadata.pricing_checked_on`). T
he built-in China public-holiday calendar covers **2026 only**. Prices are not fetched at runtime.
Registering one tool:
| Tool | What it returns |
| `deepseek_pricing_tier` | `tier` (`peak`/`off`), the canonical `reason` key (shared with the panel
and its CLI), Beijing wall clock, today's peak windows, the next switch time + countdown, per-model
prices from the bundled rate card (checked 2026-10-15; not a live fetch), `data_metadata` (pricing-
check date + source + holiday-year coverage; holidays are 2026 only), `calendar_coverage` / `current
_calendar_covered` / `warnings`, and — when `days > 0` — the upcoming switches in the rolling window
`[at, at + days×24h)` |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin` activates it as a profile layer. Restart `d
sh --profile web` afterwards, then check **Settings → Plugins**. Peer dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/co
rdis` (^4.0.1; both of the DSH lines below ship 4.0.5) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (`^0.0.1-rc.1 ||
^0.2.0-rc.2`). DSH 0.2 compares its own runtime version to each `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range wit
h prerelease matching, and that range covers the 0.0.1-rc line and the 0.2.x line from 0.2.0-rc.2.
## Why an agent wants this
Off-peak is **exactly 50% of peak**. DeepSeek's pricing page states the peak windows but **does not
say how a request that spans a tier boundary is assigned**, so this plugin does not claim to know: t
reat the actual bill as the authority. What it does tell you is which tier an instant falls in:
> peak hours are Beijing (UTC+8) Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese public holid
ays; everything else — weekday nights, the 12:00–14:00 lunch break, all weekend, all holidays — is h
thing else — weekday nights, the 12:00–14:00 lunch break, all weekend, all holidays — is half price.
So a job that can wait costs half as much. The tool is pure arithmetic on a bundled rate card transc
ribed from DeepSeek's pricing page on 2026-10-15, plus a China holiday calendar that covers 2026 onl
y: **no network calls, no API key, no credentials**, `isConcurrencySafe` is true, and it never write
work calls, no API key, no credentials**, `isConcurrencySafe` is true, and it never writes anything.

## One implementation, two consumers
The peak/off-peak rule is **not** re-implemented here. `tier.js` is generated by `tools/sync-core.mj
s` from the `/*CORE-START*/ … /*CORE-END*/` block of deepseek-pricing-panel's `index.html`, at a pin
ned commit, verbatim:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The generated file carries the source commit and the CORE block's SHA-256, and `tests/core.test.mjs`
asserts the header — so the model-facing tool and the human-facing HTML panel can never disagree ab
header — so the model-facing tool and the human-facing HTML panel can never disagree about the rule.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
18 tests, no test framework beyond Node's own runner. `tests/plugin.test.mjs` **boots the real harne
ss packages**: a real `@deepseek-ai/cordis` context with a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` tool regist
ry (`ToolRegistry` on 0.0.1-rc.1, `ToolRuntime` from 0.0.1-rc.5), mounts the plugin with `ctx.plugin
()`, and executes the tool through the registry pipeline — asserting the model-facing schema, the re
ndered summary, the JSON value, the error path for an unusable `at`, and the prompt-section wiring.
The only stand-in is the `systemPrompt` service the registry injects (a two-method stub). CI runs th
e suite on Ubuntu + Windows × Node 20/22 × `dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.5 and 0.2.0-rc.2 (both with cordis 4
.0.5), plus the drift check.
## Model names
`deepseek-flash` is **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, not V4-Flash: the legacy ids `deepseek-v4-flash` / `dee
pseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` still resolve, but those models are retired and requests are served by V4
.1-Flash at Flash prices. `deepseek-v4-pro` is DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Both ids and versions were checked o
n 2026-10-10 (`data_metadata.model_mapping_checked_on`) against `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models
`. The plugin does not call that endpoint at runtime.
## Caveats
- Prices are a bundled rate card transcribed from DeepSeek's pricing page on 2026-10-15. They are no
t fetched live. If the published prices change, the card stays stale until the panel pin is regenera

ted.
- A government make-up workday (调休上班日) is **off-peak** under the rule, because DeepSeek disting

uishes only Mon–Fri from weekend.
- The built-in China holiday calendar covers 2026 only. A later ye
ar is estimated from the weekday rule and reported as uncovered (`calendar_coverage` / `warnings`) u
ntil `HOLIDAYS` is updated upstream and this package is re-pinned with `tools/sync-core.mjs`.

## 简体中文
这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，回答决定 DeepSeek API 账单的两个问题：**现在按高峰（全价）还是空闲（正好半价）计费**、**下一次切换在几点**，并给出今天的高峰窗口
。各模型单价来自**内置价目表**，于 **2026-10-15** 从 DeepSeek 定价页 誊录（即 `data_metadata.pricing_checked_on`），运行时不联网刷新。
内置的中国法定节假日日历**只覆盖 2026 年**。
注册的工具：`deepseek_pricing_tier` —— 返回 `tier`（peak/off）、判定原因、北京时间、今天的高峰窗口、下次切换时刻与倒计时、内置价目表中该档位的各模型单价（核对
日期 2026-10-15，不是实时拉取；节假日只覆盖 2026 年），可选未来若干天的切换列表。
